chunks: Do they associate those with Him who cannot create a thing, and are themselves created,
ai.seo_question: Why do polytheists associate partners with God if their idols are created and cannot create?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Al-A'raf, this verse critiques the logical inconsistency of polytheists who worship created entities that are themselves subject to creation and decay. Shia exegetes emphasize this as a fundamental proof of Tawhid, illustrating that true divinity requires independent creative power (Khalq) rather than mere existence, thereby invalidating the status of idols as co-creators or intercessors.
